breakdown.description: Gamma-centered k-point sampling conflicts with a half-shifted Monkhorst-Pack mesh.
breakdown.reason: The generated specification repeats the conflict instead of fixing it: it explicitly says 'gamma-centered Monkhorst-Pack k-point grid with a half shift,' which is the same contradictory instruction identified in the inconsistency. The ground truth removes the half-shift requirement and keeps only gamma-centered sampling.
